name: Bonds Festival
description: Discover the sounds of the Portuguese scene with a festival lineup packed with indie pop, rock, and contemporary jazz.
longDescription:
The Bonds Festival is a one-day music event showcasing a selection of Portuguese artists. The festival features performances across genres including indie pop, rock, and contemporary jazz, aiming to highlight current musical trends within the national scene. This edition takes place at Casa da Música, a prominent concert hall in Porto.

Attendees can expect an evening of live music in a dedicated performance setting. The event is scheduled to begin at 18:00 on September 19, 2026. Casa da Música is known for its modern architectural design and its role as a major cultural institution in Porto, providing a formal yet accessible environment for musical performances.

Tickets for the Bonds Festival are available for purchase. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus routes also serve the area.
